question: This dataset is raw paired-end FASTQ (6 samples, /data/inputs/reads) that has never been quantified — no gene/transcript count matrix exists yet. Differential expression cannot start from FASTQ directly: quantification (alignment + counting, e.g. STAR+featureCounts/HISAT2, or pseudo-alignment via Salmon/kallisto) is a separate upstream step with its own decisions (aligner, reference build, decoys, annotation) that materially change the abundance estimates. I checked the sandbox exhaustively and none of the standard quantification tools are available: STAR, HISAT2, Bowtie2, BWA, Salmon, kallisto, Subread/featureCounts, Rsubread, and tximport are all absent from the Python and R (CRAN/Bioconductor/GitHub) package census, and the environment has no installable CLI/binary packages at all (nothing to link in at runtime). On the reference side, the store holds a GENCODE v50 human GTF (GRCh38, chr-prefixed) but no genome FASTA or transcriptome index suitable for alignment (only a PharmCAT-bundled bgzipped GRCh38 FASTA meant for VCF preprocessing, not a general aligner reference). Given no quantification tool exists in this environment, I cannot plan a working path from these FASTQs to a DE gene list. Please either (a) provide a pre-computed gene-level count matrix or transcript-level quantification (e.g., Salmon/kallisto quant.sf or STAR/featureCounts counts) for these 6 samples, matched to the metadata.csv condition labels, or (b) provision an RNA-seq quantification tool (Salmon, kallisto, STAR, or Rsubread) plus a matching genome/transcriptome reference in this environment so quantification can run as a first step before differential expression.
